task.instruction: Grade check-plan.py and tree_plan.py as the checker of tree plan files.

world.deliverable: a command-line checker run by the tree skill's author and fixtures

task.evidence_goal: the checker accepts every valid plan, refuses every malformed one with a named rule, and follows the repository's script rules

criteria.text: Run on a valid plan file, the script prints `ok 1` and exits 0.

provenance.source: a checker that refuses a valid plan blocks the owner's page

criteria.text: Run on a plan with an unknown key, the script exits 1 with the rule name `unknown-key` in its output.

provenance.source: a checker that accepts a malformed plan lets a broken page reach the owner

criteria.text: Run on a plan file that writes one key twice in an object, the script exits 1 and prints the rule name `duplicate-key`.

provenance.source: json.loads keeps only the last duplicate, so a plain loader accepts it

criteria.text: Run on a plan holding an `evidence` part without a source, the script exits 1 with the rule name `evidence-needs-source` in its output.

provenance.source: evidence with no source cannot be opened by the reader

tiers.name: fails safe and in form for the caller

criteria.text: Run with no argument, the script exits 2, prints nothing on stdout and prints its docstring on stderr.
Run on a path that does not exist, the script exits 1 and prints a line holding `unreadable`, with no `Traceback` on stderr.

provenance.source: a stack trace hides which file was wrong

criteria.text: Run on a file of invalid UTF-8 bytes, the script exits 1 with an error line and no `Traceback` on stderr.

provenance.source: UnicodeDecodeError is not an OSError, a gap the handler may miss

criteria.text: Run with `--expect-refused` on one refused plan file, the script prints a last line `refused 1 of 1` and exits 0.
The script's docstring opens with a purpose sentence and holds one `usage:` line per call form.
The script defines `def main(args)` and ends with `sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))`.
Every rule name that `tree_plan.check` can emit appears in the tree skill's `references/grammar.md`.

provenance.source: a rule the author cannot look up leaves the error unexplained

criteria.text: `tree_plan.py` opens a file only in `load_file` and imports no network module.

provenance.source: the lib docstring: every function is a calculation

criteria.text: A comment in either file restates what the next line does instead of why.
criteria.anchors: restates: removing the comment loses no reason, only a paraphrase of the code line.
variants_ok: # A *-plan.json is the valid plan an answer fixture is applied to, so it is checked to be accepted

exchange.note: a wrong verdict misleads the caller; a wrong usage code only confuses it

monitor: program checks and the judge criterion disagree on the same file
